messages.content: I’ll keep reserve awards within the battery’s state-of-charge and shared-meter limits, charge during the low-price solar hours, and target the DA energy-price peak for discharge. I’ll then adjust energy dispatch at each watch; AS awards will be fixed after this commit.

The commit accepted the morning and solar-hour awards, but refused the hour-18 reserve package and the later RRS awards on SoC rules. Those AS positions are now fixed at zero. I’ll use the resulting evening dispatch flexibility and restore the battery to its end-of-day target.

Through 17:00, realized profit is $22,454.69. The battery delivered 75 MWh in hour 17, which settled at $72.94/MWh RT. Hour 18’s frozen dispatch will exhaust the remaining SoC; the late-hour charging book is set to restore at least 75 MWh by midnight.
